meta.title: English school in Vilanova del Camí | English Corner
meta.description: English school in Vilanova del Camí (Anoia). Groups of no more than 8, every area of the language, and an authorised Cambridge English exam preparation centre.
meta.ogTitle: English school in Vilanova del Camí
meta.ogDescription: A structured method, every area of the language, and groups of eight. From age four through to adults.

hero.lede: A structured method, every area of the language, and groups of eight. From age four through to adults.

creds.cambridgeNote: We prepare students and enter them for the official exam here.
creds.localNote: More than 500 students prepared, rated 4.9 on average.

marquee: Over 15 years in Vilanova del Camí

courses.h2:
A structured path,
from A1 to C1.
courses.lede: Every group follows a structured syllabus, working all five areas in each unit. Students progress level by level, and sit the official exam when they are genuinely ready.

items.title: Kids & Juniors
items.desc: Structured from the start, following the Starters, Movers and Flyers progression. Reading, writing, listening and speaking in every unit.

items.title: Teens
items.desc: Grammar, vocabulary and use of English worked systematically, alongside the four skills. School results improve as a consequence, not as the goal.

items.title: Cambridge Exams
items.desc: A2 Key, B1 Preliminary, B2 First and C1 Advanced. Full paper-by-paper preparation with mock exams under real conditions, in our own authorised centre.

items.title: Adults
items.desc: The same structured method, adapted to adult pace. Solid grammar foundations, systematic vocabulary and the confidence that comes from actually knowing the language.

items.title: Business English
items.desc: Professional writing, meetings, calls and presentations, built on the same grammatical rigour. In-company sessions available across the Anoia area.

exams.lede: Our students don't just study English, they certify it. We prepare each level in full and enter candidates for the official examination as an authorised Cambridge English centre.

rungs.name: Key (KET)
rungs.desc: The first official certificate. Proves a solid grasp of everyday written and spoken English.

rungs.name: Preliminary (PET)
rungs.desc: Independent user level. Required by many secondary schools and increasingly by universities.

rungs.name: First (FCE)
rungs.desc: The most requested certificate in Spain. Standard requirement for degree programmes and most job applications.

rungs.name: Advanced (CAE)
rungs.desc: Proficient user. Opens doors to postgraduate study, international universities and professional roles abroad.

exams.yleNote: The Young Learners series, designed so children build the same foundations from age 7, without pressure.

method.h2:
A method that has
been proven for
fifteen years.
method.lede: We follow a structured progression, the same one the Cambridge teaching blocks use. Nothing is skipped, nothing is improvised.

pillars.title: All five areas, every unit
pillars.text: Reading, writing, listening, speaking and use of English. Grammar and vocabulary worked properly, not left to chance.

pillars.title: Never more than 8 in a room
pillars.text: Small enough for the teacher to correct every piece of written work and hear every student in every class.

pillars.title: You move up when you're ready
pillars.text: Nobody advances just because the course ended. You move up when all five areas are there, and the teacher decides that with the work in front of them.

pillars.title: Teachers who stay
pillars.text: Qualified, experienced and here year after year. Your child will not get a different teacher every term.

reviews.h2: Don't take our word for it.

items.name: Marta S.
items.quote: My daughter has been going for four years. She went through Movers and Flyers and passed B1 Preliminary first time. The progression is clear and you can see it term by term.

items.name: Jordi R.
items.quote: What convinced me was the structure. There's a syllabus, there's homework, there's correction. After two years I passed B2 First, and I actually understood why I passed.

items.name: Anna P.
items.quote: What I value most is that they know my son. They noticed he was struggling with reading before we did, and they adapted. You don't get that in a big academy.

insta.lede: Halloween parties, exam results, summer camps and everything in between.
insta.note: We post what happens at the academy here: exam results, activities and day-to-day school life.

contact.h2:
Come in for a free
trial class.
contact.lede: Bring your child, or come yourself. One class, no commitment, no pressure, just so you can see how we work before deciding anything.
